title: Futuristic big indoor mall with apartments
content: Hi all- I'm so happy to have just stumbled across this sub. Long story short, during the pandemic I dabbled in hypnosis videos every night to "astrally project", in not really knowing what that meant...fast forward and I've been having recurring dreams of an alternate universe that I'm certain exists either simultaneously or futuristically...it's very much set up like a city but all indoors...including a big mall and hotel like apartments and an airport and train station...in fact, I'm sure I've come across some of you in the food court...all I'm saying is that I'm happy this exists. This shared experience of seeing behind the curtain...
